## Description

Use this call to remove selected messages for a given user. DeleteMyMessages accepts only ten unique MessageID values per request.

**Purpose:**
Use this call to remove selected messages for a given user. DeleteMyMessages accepts only ten unique MessageID values per request. If the call is successful, it returns Success (no other information is returned).

**Use Cases:**
- Deletes one or more My Messages entries for the authenticated user.

**Important Notes:**
- Deletes one or more My Messages entries for the authenticated user.
